spans.text: Born from a corruption in nature spilling out into its wildlife, yuamorians are a unique type of fiend that is not tethered to a plane or origin. Rather, they are bound to the place in which they first manifested and, if killed, will return to life from the earth there. If killed in their home (within several hundred feet of it, for example), they die permanently. Filled with anger and resentment, these fiends are the wrath of nature given form.

They are more common on Degozah than anywhere else in the universe due to their highly naturalistic culture and strong reverence for wildlife. This sense of spirituality endows the land there with a stronger mystical presence, but this also means it is more easily influenced in a negative direction.

Sometimes yuamorians might manifest due to the influence of other fiends on an environment. Other fiends—particularly devils—sometimes manage to coerce the yuamorians to their side, treating them as simplistic brutes who can be rewarded with territory, food, or praise. Demons don’t commonly get along with them due to their similarly brutish nature, and the two simply fight for dominance.

This breed of fiend follows an animal-like set of principles. They hunt when hungry, fight back against industrialization and the influence of mankind (in a rage, and without claiming they are agents of protection), and protect territory they feel is theirs. They are simplistic like many demons, but are not born of the same organic chaos.

“That which is unsightly can make a fine trophy. What is eye-catching and what is beautiful are not always in concert. Fiends are a pervasive, unquenchable form of life, and so acquiring them from time to time is more than exciting. Keeping them on one plane is tricky though.”
